title: SKF_DROP_SKILL_RESULT_JSON envelope (v1)
description: Single-line JSON document skf-drop-skill emits when {headless_mode} is true, prefixed with the literal 'SKF_DROP_SKILL_RESULT_JSON: ': on stdout when step 3 reports a finished drop, on stdout when a --dry-run stops at the step 1 confirmation gate, and on stderr at every HARD HALT. The shared emitter builds each line from the payload a stage gives it, so pipelines branch on status and halt_reason without parsing the human-readable report. src/skf-drop-skill/references/headless-contract.md describes each field.

skf-envelope.description: The shared emitter's settings for this workflow, read by skf-emit-result-envelope.py: the workflow, the line's prefix, the status a halt carries, the exit code of each halt_reason and the result file stem. Nothing in the schema references this entry, so it constrains no envelope.

status.description: 'success' when step 3 reports a finished drop (also when some purge folders could not be deleted: the result file's own status says 'partial' then). 'dry-run' when --dry-run stopped at the step 1 confirmation gate before any change. 'error' at every HARD HALT.

skill.description: The skill the run selected. Null when the run halted before one was selected.

drop_mode.description: 'deprecate' (manifest only, files kept) or 'purge' (files deleted too). Null when the run halted before the mode was decided.

versions_affected.description: The versions the drop covers: a list holding the one version dropped, or 'all' for a drop of the whole skill. An empty list when the run halted before the scope was chosen.

files_deleted.description: The absolute folder paths a purge deleted. Empty for a deprecate, a dry run and a HALT (a purge that deleted nothing halts with delete-failed).

would_delete.description: Dry run of a purge only: the absolute folder paths the purge would delete (the purge check's affected_directories), so a pipeline can check the blast radius before it runs the drop. Empty otherwise, and for a dry run in deprecate mode.

forge_left_in_place.description: The forge folder a purge leaves in place (or, in a dry run, would leave) because SKF did not generate it. Null otherwise, and in deprecate mode.

manifest_updated.description: True when step 2 wrote the export manifest. False for a draft skill (it has no manifest entry), a dry run and a HALT before the write; a failed manifest write halts with manifest-write-failed.

result_path.description: The per-run result file the emitter wrote for a finished drop, {skills_output_folder}/drop-skill-result-<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>.json (UTC), beside its drop-skill-result-latest.json copy. Stamped by the emitter, never typed. Null for a dry run and a HALT, which write no result file, and when the write failed (warnings say why).

exit_code.description: Process exit code matching the SKILL.md Exit Codes table, derived from halt_reason: null gives 0, input-missing and input-invalid 2, manifest-corrupt and nothing-to-drop 3, manifest-write-failed, context-rebuild-failed, delete-failed and write-failed 4, active-version-guard-refused and not-skf-output 5, headless-purge-forbidden and user-cancelled 6.

halt_reason.description: Null on success and on a dry run. One of the documented HALT classes on error, so a pipeline surfaces the right operator message without parsing the prose.

phase.description: The step and gate that halted, such as 'select:scope' or 'execute:manifest-write'.

path.description: The file or folder the failed operation targeted, when the halt names one.

error.description: Null on success and on a dry run. On a HALT, the step that halted and its message.

warnings.description: Optional. Non-fatal anomalies the run recorded, one string each, such as result_file_write_failed when the result file could not be written. Present only when there is at least one.
